title: How much work buys an hour of light, then and now?
subtitle: In 1800 an hour of bulb-bright light cost over five hours of work. Guess what it costs now, and see light become history's great bargain.
form: ask on a log scale (guess on a number line)
notes: Nordhaus series ends in 1992: the voice says 'by 1992'. Scale markers 2–3 hidden at the start, drawn after the reveal. Ask 'keep': true does not keep the viewer's 'You' marker after the reveal in frames (engine). Scale ticks only grow via the global text font_size (30 here). The answer pin is always red (engine colour), so 1992 is blue elsewhere. Ending: two clock faces (sectors) — 11 minutes vs ~350 days per hour of work.
